meta.name: scope
meta.description: Assess a new customer request against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership. Use when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估新需求是否超出约定范围,给出取舍与归属判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户临时加需求,你需要判断该不该答应。
copy.tagline_en: Judge whether a new customer request fits the agreed scope before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a client keeps adding requests and you must decide what to commit

howto.what: 遇到客户新需求或定制功能要不要答应时,它会对照已约定的范围、取舍与归属做评估,并区分实施、验证、部署与验收,保留未知项。它直接基于你给的上下文工作,不需要初始化。
howto.when: 当合作范围扩大,或某项定制功能需要做出承诺决定时触发。

say.text: 客户又提了个新需求,帮我对照原定范围看看该不该接
say.note: 得到一份对照范围与取舍的评估

say.text: 这个定制功能要不要向客户承诺?帮我评估取舍和归属
say.note: 给出承诺前需权衡的取舍与责任方

say.text: 范围在扩大,帮我区分哪些是实施、部署,哪些是验收
say.note: 按四个阶段拆开当前事项

howto.what_en: When a customer request or a custom feature needs a commitment decision, it assesses it against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership, separating implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance, and preserving unknowns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

say_en.text: The customer raised a new request — check it against our agreed scope.
say_en.note: Returns an assessment against agreed scope

say_en.text: Should we commit to this custom feature? Weigh the trade-offs and ownership.
say_en.note: Shows the trade-offs and owners to weigh

say_en.text: Scope is expanding — separate implementation, deployment and acceptance.
say_en.note: Splits the work across these stages
